task: Q1 independent expected cases, materialised in the Q2 node.md + trees/ representation (move/reorder/rename slice only)

provenance.authored_by: Qwen worker lane, hand-prescribed from laws/CONTRACT.md groups 1-4 and the reviewed ordered-placement decision in Flat Relationship Store. No value in this file was produced by running the implementation under test.
provenance.representation_adapted_by: Q2 Markdown native integration: spelling and materialisation only. Prescriptions were authored by Q1 against the provisional JSON payload layout and re-expressed here for node.md/trees/; no expected graph, request, preservation claim, wrong-result control or draft verdict was changed.

excluded: general Markdown editing beyond the reviewed slice
scope.statement: These cases prescribe the existing reviewed slice only. A PASS here is about this fixture and the interface it exercises; it is not proof of the whole Core, nor of the compiled policy's universal adequacy.

interface.read_from: src/main.rs and src/lib.rs at the imported Markdown revision 047f25a204026482a3e13040a5eb029434bd9653 (not invented)
interface.cli: sifttext-file-graph validate|inspect STORE ; move|reorder|rename STORE NODE ARG ; validate-draft BEFORE AFTER KIND NODE ARG
notes: NODE and ARG are resolved by unique-prefix resolution; an absent or ambiguous prefix is a rejection, not a guess.
For rename, ARG is the new display name, not a UUID.
Rejection prints 'rejected: ' on stderr and exits nonzero; the store is not written.
validate-draft compares the completed ordinary native draft against the checked operation byte-for-byte and graph-for-graph.
The store is the node.md + trees/ layout: nodes/<UUID>/node.md plus nodes/<UUID>/children/<UUID> symlinks and nodes/<UUID>/children.order, with trees/<root-UUID> -> ../nodes/<root-UUID>.
A checked rename replaces only the JSON string value of the node.md name metadata with a compact JSON string; reserialising the file is a different candidate and must be rejected, not normalised.

conventions.expected_graphs: Keyed by full UUID. nodes/<uuid> carries exactly name, micro_summary, content, children (the only authored parentage and sibling order) and see_also. No authored parent or order field.
conventions.derived_parents: Derived view recomputed from children by the checker; prescribed here so a wrong derivation is detected.
conventions.label_tokens: In paths and prescriptions, {L} resolves to labels[L] and '*' means every node UUID of the graph being examined.
conventions.paths: Store-relative POSIX paths. A child entry path is the child symlink; children.order is the authored sequence; node.md is the authored payload (front matter plus the verbatim Markdown body). Root shortcuts live under trees/ and are not part of any prescribed changed-path inventory.
conventions.placement: move appends the node to the end of the destination parent's children (laws/CONTRACT.md group 1); reorder places the node immediately after the named sibling inside the same parent; rename changes only the display name.
conventions.same_parent_move: Moving a node under its current parent is accepted by the frozen spec and is an append, i.e. a move to the end of that parent's sequence; it is prescribed here as reviewed-spec behaviour, not as a new placement argument.
conventions.payload_bytes: The data layer keeps the neutral field name content for the authored body. In node.md it is every byte after the closing metadata fence; a rename changes only the JSON string value of the name key and no other byte.
